title: Answer key
description: Stored by PUT /admin/sheet/:id and never returned by GET /sheet/:id. Keep the filled key out of this public repository. Hinge ids, if used, belong here unless they are confirmed harmless to publish.

accept.description: Accepted responses. A string or a list. Compared after the scorer's normalization, or as choice ids.

action.description: Specific next step shown after Finish when this item is not yet right. Do not name a mix-up.

not_attempted_action.description: Specific next step shown after Finish when this item was left blank.

note.description: A note already recorded for this item. Omit it when there is no verified note. Never a mix-up id.

match.description: token: every word of an accept value appears in the response. Useful for angle names such as CQF inside 'angle CQF'.

rubric.description: How a person or a vision check should mark a photo.

wrong.description: Normalized wrong response -> misconception id. Ids only.

steps.description: Shown only after the student presses Finish.
